# Return on arriving at Forward Port… or Share a Port… never closes a
# forward: a page's "Close" rows are never picked for the user, however the
# page was reached, and typing then deleting doesn't leave one picked. The
# stand-in ssh really carries the three forwards; @FORWARDS@ lists those up.
# Run with --persist (libertty +forward asks this window's app).
size:1280x800
pretend-host:liberttytest
fake-forward:open:5173
fake-forward:open:5174
fake-forward:share:3000
wait:1.0
type:echo "BEFORE=$(wc -l < @FORWARDS@ | tr -d ' ')"
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect:BEFORE=3
# Picked from a search, the command is row 0; on its page row 0 is a Close.
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.5
type:forw
wait:0.4
expect-palette:Forward Port
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-palette:Close 5173 → 
expect-palette-selected:none
key:enter
wait:1.0
# Typed (the Forward row picked), then deleted (only Close rows left).
type:5174
wait:0.4
expect-palette-selected:Forward localhost:5174
key:backspace
key:backspace
key:backspace
key:backspace
wait:0.4
expect-palette-selected:none
key:enter
wait:1.0
key:escape
wait:0.3
key:escape
wait:0.3
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.5
type:share a port
wait:0.4
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-palette-selected:none
key:enter
wait:1.0
key:escape
wait:0.3
key:escape
wait:0.3
type:echo "AFTER=$(wc -l < @FORWARDS@ | tr -d ' ')"
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect:AFTER=3
# Closed by hand (the row picked first), and Edit ▸ Undo asks for it again.
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.5
type:forw
wait:0.4
key:enter
wait:0.5
key:down
expect-palette-selected:Close 5173 → 
key:enter
wait:1.5
expect-undo:Close Forward
type:echo "CLOSED=$(wc -l < @FORWARDS@ | tr -d ' ')"
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect:CLOSED=2
undo:go
wait:1.5
type:echo "UNDONE=$(wc -l < @FORWARDS@ | tr -d ' ')"
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect:UNDONE=3
expect-undo:none
# Or its page's Undo Close, which isn't picked for you either.
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.5
type:forw
wait:0.4
key:enter
wait:0.5
key:down
key:enter
wait:1.5
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.5
type:forw
wait:0.4
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-palette-selected:none
key:up
expect-palette-selected:Undo Close 
key:enter
wait:1.5
type:echo "AGAIN=$(wc -l < @FORWARDS@ | tr -d ' ')"
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect:AGAIN=3
# Their stand-in listeners go with them.
type:libertty +forward close --all; echo "CLOSED=$? LEFT=$(wc -l < @FORWARDS@ | tr -d ' ')"
key:enter
wait:3.0
expect:CLOSED=0 LEFT=0
